channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Priyanka Chopra takes off for Hyderabad: ‘I’ll see you soon’
item.description: Actress Priyanka Chopra is a true global star, and thanks to her work, she keeps moving between continents.

item.title: Fresh snowfall shuts highways in Kashmir, affects flight operations
item.description: Due to fresh snowfall on Tuesday, the strategic Srinagar-Jammu national highway was closed for traffic, while all morning flights at Srinagar International Airport were cancelled.

item.title: Rajasthan MeT Department issues orange, yellow alerts warning of rain, thunderstorms
item.description: The Meteorological Department on Tuesday issued a yellow and orange alert in parts of the state, warning of rain accompanied by hailstorms and thunderstorms in around 20 districts.

item.title: JD(U) Slams Congress–DMK INDIA Bloc, Warns of ‘Alliance Cracks’ in Tamil Nadu
item.description: Janata Dal(U) National Spokesperson Rajeev Ranjan Prasad on Tuesday said that the recent remarks by leaders within the DMK have exposed growing fault lines within the Congress-led INDIA bloc, claiming that the opposition grouping is steadily losing public support and cohesion.

item.title: Lokesh Kanakaraj trashes reports claiming he unfollowed Rajinikanth, Kamal Haasan on social media
item.description: Trashing reports that claimed that he had unfollowed Tamil Superstar Rajinikanth and legendary actor Kamal Haasan on social media, ace director Lokesh Kanakaraj has now clarified he had done nothing of that sort and urged the media to check facts with him or his team before putting out such reports about him.

item.title: Bangladesh: Attack on Crime Reporters Association leaves 10 journalists injured
item.description: As violence against the press continues to escalate in Bangladesh under the Muhammad Yunus-led interim government, at least 10 journalists were injured in an attack on members of the Bangladesh Crime Reporters Association (CRAB) in Narsingdi district, local media reported.

item.title: Madras High Court scraps order granting immediate censor clearance to Vijay’s movie ‘Jana Nayagan’
item.description: In a significant setback to the makers of Vijay-starrer 'Jana Nayagan', a Division Bench of the Madras High Court on Tuesday allowed an appeal filed by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) and set aside a single-judge direction that had ordered the immediate grant of censor certification to the film.

item.title: How realme is shaping future of comfortable listening with Buds Clip
item.description: Wireless audio has become a constant companion in everyday life, with earbuds now used across work calls, entertainment, fitness, travel, and casual listening.

item.title: Seven suffer burn injuries in cylinder blast-triggered fire in Mumbai’s Malad
item.description: At least seven people suffered burn injuries after a fire broke out due to a gas cylinder blast in the Malad area of Mumbai on Tuesday morning, officials from the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) disaster management cell said.

item.title: Hindus in Bangladesh at Risk as Election Politics Turns Violent, Says Intelligence Sources
item.description: A plot has been engineered in Bangladesh to incite violence against the minority Hindus ahead of the February elections.
